import datetime, re
sn_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='ch.brow@gmail.com', password='LddQFtz')['access_token']

# Find note_id for title containing 'Exercise Plan'
matching=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    res=apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=sn_token, query='Exercise Plan', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    print('simple_note search page',page_index,'count',len(res))
    if not res:
        break
    matching.extend(res)
    page_index+=1
    if page_index>50:
        break
print('total matching',len(matching))
# Prefer exact title match
note_candidates=[n for n in matching if n['title'].strip().lower()=='exercise plan']
if note_candidates:
    note_id=note_candidates[0]['note_id']
else:
    note_id=matching[0]['note_id']
print('chosen note_id',note_id,'title', [n['title'] for n in matching[:3]])

note=apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=sn_token)
content=note['content']

weekday=datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%A').lower()
print('weekday',weekday)

# Parse duration_mins per day
# Capture day: <day> then later duration_mins: <num> before next day:
segments=re.split(r"\n\s*day:\s*", content)
# first split part before first day
map_d={} 
for seg in segments[1:]:
    # seg starts with '<day>\n...'
    # extract day name up to newline
    lines=seg.splitlines()
    if not lines: 
        continue
    day_name=lines[0].strip().lower()
    m=re.search(r"duration_mins:\s*(\d+)", seg)
    if m:
        map_d[day_name]=int(m.group(1))
print('parsed durations',map_d)
workout_mins = map_d.get(weekday)
print('workout_mins_today',workout_mins)
if workout_mins is None:
    raise SystemExit('No duration for today')
workout_seconds=workout_mins*60
print('workout_seconds',workout_seconds)

import datetime, re, math

# Ensure spotify token
sp_token = apis.spotify.login(username='ch.brow@gmail.com', password='qMQyD0J')['access_token']

# Get today's workout mins from Simple Note
sn_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='ch.brow@gmail.com', password='LddQFtz')['access_token']
note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=2544, access_token=sn_token)
content = note['content']
weekday = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%A').lower()
segments = re.split(r"\n\s*day:\s*", content)
map_d={}
for seg in segments[1:]:
    lines=seg.splitlines()
    if not lines: continue
    day_name=lines[0].strip().lower()
    m=re.search(r"duration_mins:\s*(\d+)", seg)
    if m:
        map_d[day_name]=int(m.group(1))
workout_mins_today = map_d.get(weekday)
workout_seconds = workout_mins_today*60
print('weekday',weekday,'workout_mins_today',workout_mins_today)

# Candidate playlists from library search query='workout'
page_index=0
page_limit=20
all_playlists=[]
while True:
    res = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=sp_token, query='workout', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not res:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(res)
    page_index += 1
    if page_index>50:
        break
print('candidate playlists',[(p['playlist_id'],p['title'],len(p.get('song_ids',[]))) for p in all_playlists])

# Fetch full playlists and compute total duration
playlist_stats=[]
for p in all_playlists:
    pid=p['playlist_id']
    details=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=sp_token)
    songs=details.get('songs',[])
    total_dur=sum(s.get('duration',0) for s in songs)
    playlist_stats.append((pid, details.get('title'), len(songs), total_dur))
print('playlist_stats:')
for s in playlist_stats:
    print(s)

# Pick playlist with total_dur >= workout_seconds, else max total_dur
qualified=[s for s in playlist_stats if s[3] >= workout_seconds]
print('qualified',qualified)
if qualified:
    # choose smallest overage to keep it tight
    chosen=min(qualified, key=lambda x: x[3]-workout_seconds)
else:
    chosen=max(playlist_stats, key=lambda x: x[3])
print('chosen',chosen)
